background.description: Sets the color used for the background of the Processing display window.

color.description: Creates colors for storing in variables of the color datatype.

draw.description: Called directly after setup() and continuously executes the lines of code contained inside its block.

ellipse.description: Draws an ellipse to the screen.

fill.description: Sets the color used to fill shapes.

signatures: line(x1, y1, z1, x2, y2, z2)
line.description: Draws a line between two points.

mouseX.description: System variable containing the current horizontal coordinate of the mouse.

mouseY.description: System variable containing the current vertical coordinate of the mouse.

noLoop.description: Stops Processing from continuously executing draw().

rect.description: Draws a rectangle to the screen.

setup.description: Runs once when the program starts and is used to define initial environment properties.

size.description: Defines the dimension of the display window in units of pixels.

stroke.description: Sets the color used to draw lines and borders around shapes.

strokeWeight.description: Sets the width of the stroke used for lines, points, and shape borders.

width.description: System variable containing the width of the display window.

height.description: System variable containing the height of the display window.
